items.exampleEn: The ranger checks the forest every morning for signs of fire.
items.exampleZh: 那位管理員每天早上巡視森林，查看有沒有起火的跡象。

items.exampleEn: In many countries, a white dove is a symbol of peace.
items.exampleZh: 在許多國家，白鴿是和平的象徵。

items.exampleEn: The lake looked silver in the moonlight.
items.exampleZh: 在月光下，湖面看起來是銀色的。

items.exampleEn: The dog lifted its paw when I asked it to shake hands.
items.exampleZh: 我叫那隻狗握手，牠就舉起腳掌。

items.exampleEn: Long ago, people made pens and baskets from reeds.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，人們用蘆葦做筆和籃子。

items.exampleEn: Farmers turned the barren hill into a green tea garden over ten years.
items.exampleZh: 農民花了十年，把荒蕪的山丘變成一片綠油油的茶園。

items.exampleEn: Scientists study lava to learn what lies deep inside the earth.
items.exampleZh: 科學家研究熔岩，以了解地球深處有什麼。

items.exampleEn: My mother grows white orchids by the kitchen window.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽在廚房窗邊種白色蘭花。

items.sentenceEn: Our cat hurt its paw, so it is walking slowly today.
items.sentenceZh: 我們家的貓弄傷了腳掌，所以今天走得很慢。

items.audioEn: The ranger says the trail is closed this afternoon because of strong winds.
items.audioZh: 管理員說，因為強風，步道今天下午關閉。

items.sentenceEn: Some ducks were hiding among the tall reeds by the river.
items.sentenceZh: 有幾隻鴨子躲在河邊高高的蘆葦叢裡。

items.sentenceEn: This orchid only flowers once a year, but it smells wonderful.
items.sentenceZh: 這株蘭花一年只開一次花，但非常香。

items.stemEn: When the volcano woke up, red-hot ____ poured into the sea.
items.stemZh: 火山甦醒時，炙熱的熔岩流進了海裡。

items.stemEn: The island looked ____, with no trees and only rocks and sand.
items.stemZh: 那座島看起來很荒蕪，沒有樹，只有石頭和沙子。

items.passageEn: Last year, my family visited a volcano park in Hawaii. A friendly ranger and his small crew led our walk across fields of black rock where lava had flowed years before. Most of the land was barren, but here and there, small plants were growing through the cracks. Near a quiet pond, we saw reeds, wild orchids and a pair of doves drinking water. The ranger also showed us the paw prints of a small wild cat in the mud. That night, we walked back to our hotel in the moonlight, and my brother said it felt like being on another planet.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們全家去參觀夏威夷的一座火山公園。一位親切的管理員和他的小團隊帶我們走過一片黑色岩石地，那裡多年前曾有熔岩流過。大部分的土地都很荒蕪，但到處都有小植物從裂縫裡長出來。在一個安靜的池塘邊，我們看到蘆葦、野生蘭花，還有一對鴿子在喝水。管理員也指給我們看泥巴裡一隻小野貓的腳印。那天晚上，我們在月光下走回飯店，弟弟說感覺就像在另一個星球上。

questions.questionZh: 在池塘邊他們看到什麼？
options: 一群正在池邊喝水的鹿

questions.questionZh: 弟弟說月光下走回飯店的感覺像什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們在月光下沿著海灘散步。
referenceEn: We walked along the beach in the moonlight.
We took a walk on the beach by moonlight.
rubricZh: 「在月光下」可寫，例如 in the moonlight、by moonlight、under the moonlight 等

items.instructionZh: 用 ranger 造一個句子，說說你遇過的公園管理員或對這份工作的想法。
referenceEn: I think working as a forest ranger would be peaceful but lonely.
A ranger once helped my family when we got lost on a mountain trail.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示修正：第③關 FIX：評分要點封閉寫法
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："moonlight 常用 in the moonlight、by moonlight"；改後："「在月光下」可寫，例如 in the moonlight、by moonlight、under the moonlight 等"
